![](./assets/images/Self_Photo.png ){width=25%} 

I am an oceanographer working at NOAA's Geophysical Fluid Dynamics Laboratory.  My research interests include ocean turbulence and mixing, air-sea interaction and fluxes, and developing ocean and wave models.
